cypher: MATCH (g:gene)-[r:effector_gene]->(o:ontology) WHERE g.name = "PTPN22" AND toLower(o.name) CONTAINS "type 1 diabetes" WITH collect(DISTINCT g) + collect(DISTINCT o) AS nodes, collect(DISTINCT r) AS edges RETURN nodes, edges;
summary:
PTPN22 is classified as an effector gene in the context of Type 1 Diabetes (T1D). This classification is supported by strong genetic evidence, including a protein-altering variant in PTPN22 that is causal for T1D, as well as regulatory links identified in CD4 T cells through pcHi-C studies [pubmed id: 34012112, 28870212]. These findings highlight its critical role in T1D pathogenesis.

Additionally, literature evidence confirms that PTPN22 is a major genetic risk factor for T1D. The R620W polymorphism in PTPN22 is strongly associated with increased T1D susceptibility and influences T-cell activation, immune regulation, and autoimmunity mechanisms [pubmed id: 23193190, 28751955]. These insights underscore PTPN22"s vital role in modulating immune responses and its significance as an effector gene in T1D.
